pages.text: Start your 5x ore chain — Mekanism is the T3–T4 tech mod: ore processing, gas handling, advanced machines, and the road to MekaSuit.

$(bold)T3 access:$() Basic Mekanism machines (Enrichment Chamber, Purification Chamber, Crusher, Chemical Injection) unlock at T3. Osmium is the T3 base material.$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$() Full Mekanism processing chain yields up to 5 ingots per ore. Building this chain is a major T3 engineering project.

$(bold)T4 upgrade:$() MekaTool, MekaSuit, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production are T4 content. Planning your T3 infrastructure for T4 upgrades is a good use of T3 time.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() Efficient Engineering boosts all Mekanism factory speeds. T3 Artificer is the fastest path to T4.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Mekanism is documented via JEI and the $(bold)Mekanism wiki$() (mekanismmod.com). In-game, hover any machine in JEI and press $(bold)R$() for recipes, $(bold)U$() for uses.$(br2)$(bold)Next: follow $(l:icraft:engineering/t3_five_x_chain)T3: The 5x Chain$(/l) machine by machine.$()
